Docket 1.3.140

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $59, or $29.50 at the Black Friday price until 30 November, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *AI search visibility is no longer perfect for a site with no business markup.* A site whose pages never say,
  in markup an AI crawler reads, which business they belong to could score 100 for AI search visibility, while
  a site that had added that markup but no profile links lost points. That site now gets a high-priority finding
  in this area too. It is the same job as the Structured data finding, one block on the homepage fixes both, and
  the fix plan counts it once.
- *An area whose subject is missing entirely now shows red.* No structured data on any page, no Open Graph tags
  on any page, no analytics anywhere, no HTTPS at all, every AI search crawler blocked, or every page blank to AI
  crawlers: each used to cost the area one finding's worth of points, so it could still read amber or green. Each
  now holds its area in the red. Docket applies this only where it is sure: a tracker or markup that a script adds
  is checked in a real browser first, and a gap on some pages, or a crawler you blocked by name, does not count.

99 checks across 13 areas.
